description: Ten detailed methods: mixed collection value, entered dealer sale offers, refining settlement, bounded whole-item purchase baskets, inventory margin, fabrication quotes, transaction feasibility, equivalent-lot purchase offers, replacement-cost selling price, and partially unpriced purchase exposure. Seller prices are user-entered, never fetched. Supplied USD per fine troy ounce; no prices fetched. Enter zero for unused metal prices. All schema fields are explicit; inactive content-method fields are zero. Returns detailed rows and an unsigned replayable calculation receipt. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.
